name: Aurionpro
why: aurionpro.com answers but cannot be read. TLS presents a valid Sectigo cert whose CN is literally *.aurionpro.com, but the server omits the intermediate, so verification fails with 'unable to get local issuer certificate'. add_company.fetch() returns 'unreachable: SSLError' on https://aurionpro.com and https://www.aurionpro.com; plain http 301s to https://...:443/ so there is no readable path. An independent fetcher refused it too ('unable to verify the first certificate'). The transit arm's own domain, aurotransit.com, ConnectTimeouts on every attempt. The APTA TRANSform 2026 exhibitor list does carry 'Aurionpro' (booth 3600), so the company is real and the domain is very likely theirs, but a DV cert proves only domain control, not that the page sells transit fare collection. Never read the page, so no website written. Worth a human retry: this is a misconfigured chain, not a dead site, and browsers with AIA fetching will show it fine.

name: VOCAL Technologies Inc.
quote: 520 Lee Entrance, Suite 202 Buffalo, NY 14228 Phone: +1 716-688-4675 Fax: +1 716-639-0713 Email: sales@vocal.com (c) 2026 VOCAL Technologies INC.
identity_why: identity_note: ok TRUE, present ['vocal', 'technologies'], missing []. Title is 'Voice and Data Communication Solutions | VOCAL Technologies'; name_candidates gives 'VOCAL Technologies' at score 80 as the domain-backed part of the title. The footer carries the full legal name with the suffix our record uses, plus a street address in Buffalo NY and a sales address at the same domain. Read the surprise note below before trusting vocaltechnologies.com, which is NOT them. THE TRAP, measured: vocaltechnologies.com - the .com the name-guesser reaches for, and the second candidate find_websites.candidates('VOCAL Technologies Inc.') returns - is a DomainMarket.com listing selling the name for $1,888. find_websites.identifies(html, 'VOCAL Technologies Inc.', 'vocaltechnologies') returns TRUE on it. Two guards both miss: the title 'VocalTechnologies.com - Technology Domains for Sale - ...' satisfies the identity check because it contains both name tokens, and the PARKED regex does hold a matching phrase ('domains for sale') but never sees it - identifies() only scans html[:4000], and the first PARKED hit in this 136,851-byte page sits at offset 4162, because the opening 4KB is an inline gclid tracking script. 162 bytes past the window. Nothing about vocal.com being correct depends on this; it is reported because it is a live false-positive in the one check that is supposed to stand between a squatter and the dataset.
sells_why: Voice and telephony DSP software, our description exactly. Solutions menu: VoIP, Echo Cancellation, Lawful Interception, Voice Processing, Video, Fax Modem, Data Modem, Radio Communication, Security; 'echo cancellation' x13, 'voice' x36, plus 'We cover voice compression to telephony detection for IP, radio, and mobile communications.' Fair warning on the SLED fit, not the identity: this is an embedded components licensor, and batch-3 already filed it with confidence 'low' and 'no government use case stated'. Lawful Interception and the vIPer Secure Phone are the only public-safety-adjacent lines on the page.
